How to Play

📖 How to Play

1. Choose Two Player or Vs Computer.

2. Enter your name and choose X or O.

3. Tap an empty square to place your mark.

4. Get three marks in a row — horizontally, vertically or diagonally — to win.

5. When the game ends, choose NEW GAME to play again or END to return home.
